mission.hypothesis: A CTA can reuse each staged source-particle tile across its active target threads, reducing repeated global source loads while retaining the original interaction order and exactly one target per thread. Shared storage is 256 particles (7,168 bytes); staging and synchronization overhead may outweigh reuse for some sizes, so performance remains to be measured.

retained: Use one target particle per thread and retain the existing 256-thread block mapping.
Stage up to 256 source particles at a time in dynamically allocated shared memory, reusing each tile across active target threads.
Use block-wide barriers around tile consumption; handle partial source tiles and suppress out-of-range outputs.
Set launch shared-memory allocation to 7,168 bytes for a full tile.

mission.hypothesis: Computing two targets per thread should reuse each source particle's position and mass across both interaction calculations, reducing source-load instructions per output. The explicit 128-thread/256-target mapping preserves coalesced target groups and guards partial groups. The extra accumulators and reduced thread-level parallelism may instead increase register pressure or lower occupancy; measurements across scored sizes are needed.

retained: Set block=128 and items_per_block=256, mapping each thread to targets blockIdx.x*256+threadIdx.x and that target plus 128.
Accumulate forces independently for each valid target while loading each source position and mass once per loop iteration for reuse across both targets.
Guard incomplete groups and write each valid target exactly once; keep shared_memory_bytes=0 and use no shared memory.

mission.hypothesis: Splitting the ascending source traversal into j < i and j > i ranges may remove the per-interaction self-equality test while retaining the original interaction order and arithmetic. The duplicated loop body and additional loop boundary may offset any control-flow savings; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Replace the single loop and per-iteration i == j check with two ascending loops over [0, i) and (i, n), preserving the original interaction evaluation order and arithmetic.

mission.hypothesis: La variante précédente qui annulait la masse cible a échoué à un contrôle de correction à N=16384, tandis que la séparation des plages source a passé les contrôles mais avec une différence de temps minime par rapport au baseline. Cette expérience isole une autre variante arithmétique : remplacer sqrt puis la division par un facteur basé sur rsqrtf, tout en conservant le test d'exclusion de soi et le chemin de masse cible. Elle testera si la réduction d'opérations améliore le temps sans dépasser les tolérances GPU/FP64; aucun gain n'est présumé.

retained: Remplacer sqrtf(distSq) suivi d'une division par un facteur de puissance inverse basé sur rsqrtf(distSq).
Conserver l'exclusion de j == i avant le calcul des produits de masse, ainsi que l'accumulation de force avec masse cible et la division de mise à jour par p.mass.
Ne pas modifier launch.json, le découpage en un thread par cible, ni utiliser de tiling ou de coarsening.

mission.hypothesis: The previously measured 256-thread tile was correct and faster than baseline, but its result does not isolate the tradeoff from tile size. A 128-thread CTA halves per-block shared memory to 3,584 bytes and may improve resource utilization, while also halving source reuse per tile and increasing tile iterations and barriers; measure whether any resource benefit offsets those costs. No speedup is assumed.

retained: Change CTA size and source-tile length from 256 to 128, with 3,584 bytes of dynamic shared memory for 128 Particle records.
Keep one target per thread and preserve ascending source-particle interaction order.
Retain block-wide barriers around tile consumption; all threads reach both barriers, including threads without valid output targets.
Handle partial source tiles and guard output writes for targets beyond n.

mission.hypothesis: The selected parent computes two targets per thread and measured a mean of 0.002585 s versus the baseline's 0.001844 s. This contrasting factor-four mapping tests whether further amortizing each source load across four targets improves performance, while retaining 128 lanes per block. The extra target state and accumulators, plus half as many blocks for a given N as the parent's mapping, may instead increase register pressure or reduce parallelism; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Set block=128 and items_per_block=512, with shared_memory_bytes=0.
Map each thread to up to four distinct targets at offsets 0, blockDim.x, 2*blockDim.x, and 3*blockDim.x within its block's 512-target group.
Load each source position and mass once per loop iteration and reuse those values across the valid target accumulations in registers.
Guard every target in the final partial group and write each valid output exactly once; do not use shared memory or block-level multi-output assignment.

mission.hypothesis: The measured 128-thread tile (0.00096318 s) was faster than the 256-thread tile (0.00099616 s), but the difference does not show whether a larger tile can amortize tile-loop and barrier overhead. Test a 512-thread CTA staging 512 sources (14,336 shared-memory bytes), retaining one target per thread and source order; the larger CTA and shared-memory footprint could also reduce occupancy, so no speedup is assumed.

retained: Set block and items_per_block to 512, with a 14,336-byte shared-memory allocation for 512 Particle records.
Stage source particles in CTA-sized tiles and reuse each tile across the block's active targets, keeping exactly one target per thread and ascending source interaction order.
Keep all threads participating in both barriers, including threads without valid output targets; handle partial source tiles and guard target reads and output writes.

mission.hypothesis: The measured 128-thread mappings with two and four targets per thread were both slower than the baseline, and the factor-four trial was slower than factor two. Keeping two targets per thread but using 256 threads per block with 512 targets per block tests whether more lanes and fewer targets per thread help at the same per-block target coverage as the factor-four mapping. Register pressure and block-level parallelism may still limit performance; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Set block=256, items_per_block=512, and shared_memory_bytes=0.

Load each source position and mass once per source iteration and reuse them across the valid target calculations in registers; keep each target's accumulators separate.
Write each valid target exactly once and use no shared-memory source tiling or block-level multi-output assignment.

mission.hypothesis: The split-range parent was correct but its measured mean was nearly the baseline, while the isolated rsqrtf variant was also correct and had a shorter recorded search mean. Applying the rsqrtf-based inverse-cube factor to both split loops tests whether that arithmetic change remains useful when self interactions are skipped by source ranges. The combined candidate is unmeasured; no speedup or correctness is assumed.

In both source loops, replace sqrtf(distSq) and division by distSq * dist with an rsqrtf-based inverse-cube factor; retain target-mass multiplication and the final force-per-target-mass update.
Preserve one target per thread, the current launch configuration, and all other integration and output behavior.

mission.hypothesis: Les essais mesurés ont donné 0,00096318 s pour un CTA/tile de 128, 0,00099616 s pour 256 et 0,00108797 s pour 512, tous corrects. Un bloc de 192 threads (6 warps) avec un tile source de 192 particules et 5 376 octets de mémoire partagée teste un point intermédiaire entre le meilleur bloc de 128 et le bloc de 256, pour évaluer si le compromis réutilisation/barrières et ressources s'améliore; aucun gain n'est présumé.

retained: Configurer block et items_per_block à 192 et réserver 5 376 octets de mémoire partagée pour 192 particules Particle.
Charger par tile jusqu'à 192 particules source en mémoire partagée et réutiliser ces données entre les threads de la CTA; chaque thread traite au plus une cible.

mission.hypothesis: The measured two-target/128-thread candidate (0.002585 s) was faster than the four-target/128-thread selected parent (0.004165 s), while both were slower than baseline (0.001844 s); the two-target/256-thread trial was also slower (0.002745 s). mission.hypothesis: The isolated rsqrt-based arithmetic variant was valid with a recorded search mean of 0.001009684 s, while split source ranges combined with rsqrt were also valid but recorded 0.001025174 s. mission.hypothesis: The measured 128-thread tile was faster than the 192-, 256-, and 512-thread tiles. mission.hypothesis: The four distinct catalog programs were valid. mission.hypothesis: Les mesures antérieures montrent que les plages séparées seules étaient proches du temps de base (0,0018436 s contre 0,0018444 s), tandis que le candidat valide combinant plages séparées, rsqrtf et déroulage par quatre a mesuré 0,0008995 s. Aucun gain ni résultat de correction n'est présumé avant les contrôles du contrôleur.
